title: Zesty Venezuelan Quinoa Bowl
description: A nutty, bouncy quinoa bowl packed with smoky chili, creamy avocado and bright lime, perfect for a dairy‑free date night.
instructions: Rinse quinoa under cold water and set aside.
In a medium pot, heat 2 tbsp olive oil over medium heat and sauté 1 minced clove garlic until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add 1 cup quinoa to the pot, stir to coat with oil, and toast for 2 minutes.
Pour in 2 cups vegetable broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until quinoa is tender.

While quinoa cooks, heat a skillet over medium and add 1 cup corn kernels, 1 cup black beans, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper, and pinch of crushed red pepper flakes; sauté until heated through, about 5 minutes.
Once quinoa is cooked, fluff with a fork and stir in the seasoned corn and beans mixture.
Transfer the quinoa bowl to a serving dish and top with diced red bell pepper, diced avocado, chopped cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Drizzle with extra 1 tbsp olive oil if desired and season with additional salt and pepper to taste.
Serve warm and enjoy the zesty Venezuelan flavors.
